rules: Edit ONLY the plain text fields. Keys starting with _ are context and are ignored.
Plain text only: no HTML, no markdown, no ** or [] markup. Highlighting is automatic.
Keep ALL-CAPS keywords, dice notation (D3, D6, 2D6, D6+3) and quotes/inches as written.
armyRules text is a list: one entry per paragraph.
Leave a field unchanged if you have not done it yet. Never delete a key.

text: If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within 6" of one or more friendly SYNAPSE models, that TYRANIDS unit is said to be within Synapse Range of that model and of your army. While a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army: Each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, take that test on 3D6 instead of 2D6. Each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that attack.

If your Army Faction is TYRANIDS, once per battle, in either player’s Command phase, if one or more units from your army with this ability are on the battlefield, you can unleash the Shadow in the Warp. When you do, each enemy unit on the battlefield must take a Battle-shock test. Each time an enemy unit takes such a Battle-shock test, if it is within 6" of one or more SYNAPSE units from your army, subtract 1 from that test.

rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Hyper-adaptations to be active for TYRANIDS units from your army until the end of the battle: Swarming Instincts – Each time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets an INFANTRY or SWARM unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Hyper-aggression – Each time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Hive Predators – Each time a TYRANIDS model with this Hyper-adaptation makes an attack that targets a CHARACTER unit, on a Critical Hit, that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

rapid_regeneration.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
rapid_regeneration.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
rapid_regeneration.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

adrenal_surge.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army and are eligible to fight, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army that is eligible to fight.
adrenal_surge.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in any of those selected units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

death_frenzy.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
death_frenzy.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
death_frenzy.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

overrun.when: Fight phase, just before a TYRANIDS unit from your army Consolidates.
overrun.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, instead of making that Consolidation move, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

predatory_imperative.target: Up to two TYRANIDS units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other TYRANIDS unit from your army.
predatory_imperative.effect: Select one Hyper-adaptation. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Hyper-adaptation is active for those selected units in addition to any other that may be active for your army.
predatory_imperative.restrictions: You cannot select the same Hyper-adaptation you selected at the start of the first battle round.

endless_swarm.target: Up to two Endless Multitude units from your army that are within Synapse Range of your army, or one other ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army.
endless_swarm.effect: You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to each of the selected units.

adaptive_biology.text: The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+. If, at the start of any turn, it has fewer wounds left than its starting number, it has Feel No Pain 4+ instead for the rest of the battle.

alien_cunning.text: After both armies deploy, redeploy up to three TYRANIDS units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limit.

perfectly_adapted.text: Once per turn, re-roll one hit, wound, damage, Advance or charge roll, or one saving throw, made for the bearer.

synaptic_linchpin.text: Friendly TYRANIDS units within 9" of the bearer are within your army's Synapse Range.

rule.text: Attacks by TYRANIDS models re-roll hit rolls of 1. When a BURROWER unit is set up from Reserves, place a 40mm Tunnel Marker within 1" of it and more than 3" horizontally from enemy units. In the Reinforcements step you can set up units from Reserves wholly within 9" of one of your Tunnel Markers and more than 6" horizontally from enemy units. A marker is removed when an enemy model (not AIRCRAFT) ends any move within 3" of it. MAWLOC and TRYGON units have the BURROWER keyword. At muster you can pick up to 2 TRYGON models to gain the CHARACTER keyword: they can take Enhancements and one can be your Warlord.

adaptive_optimisation.target: One Mawloc or Trygon unit from your army.
adaptive_optimisation.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit has the Synapse keyword.

replenishing_swarms.target: One Tyranids unit from your army, wholly within 9" of one or more Tunnel Markers you placed.
replenishing_swarms.effect: One model in your unit regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or you can return up to D3+1 destroyed models with a Wounds characteristic of 1 to your unit, with their full wounds remaining, instead.

enfilading_emergence.target: One Tyranids unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
enfilading_emergence.effect: Until the end of your next Fight phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

tunnel_network.target: One Tyranids unit from your army that is wholly within 9" of one or more of your Tunnel Markers and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
tunnel_network.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and set it up again, wholly within 9" of another Tunnel Marker you placed, and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy units.

swarming_assault.target: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.
swarming_assault.effect: Until the end of the phase, friendly Tyranids units within 6" of your unit can re-roll Charge rolls.

retreat_below.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
retreat_below.target: One Tyranids unit or up to two Burrower units from your army that are not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
retreat_below.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

synaptic_strategy.text: Once per battle, Rapid Ingress on the bearer's unit costs 0CP, even if another unit already used it this phase.

tremor_senses.text: After both armies deploy, redeploy up to three TYRANIDS units; they can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limit.

trygon_prime.text: TRYGON only. The bearer gains SYNAPSE and its melee weapons get +1 S and +1 WS.

vanguard_intellect.text: Models with Deep Strike only. The bearer's unit can arrive by Deep Strike in the Reinforcements step of your 1st, 2nd or 3rd Movement phase, regardless of mission rules.

rule.text: At the start of the battle round , you can select one of the Synaptic Imperatives shown below. Until the end of the battle round, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your army and while a TYRANIDS unit from your army is within Synapse Range of your army, it will benefit from it.

the_smothering_shadow.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
the_smothering_shadow.target: One Synapse unit from your army within 12" of that enemy unit.
the_smothering_shadow.effect: Roll six D6: for each 3+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

synaptic_channelling.target: One Synapse unit from your army.
synaptic_channelling.effect: Until the end of the turn, while a friendly TYRANIDS unit is within 9" of the selected unit, that unit is within Synapse Range of your army.

irresistible_will.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
irresistible_will.target: One Synapse unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase, and one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the SYNAPSE unit.
irresistible_will.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if the attacking model’s unit is within 6" of your SYNAPSE unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

reinforced_hive_node.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
reinforced_hive_node.target: One Synapse unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
reinforced_hive_node.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

imperative_dominance.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army.
imperative_dominance.effect: Select one Synaptic Imperative, even if you have already selected that imperative this battle. Until the start of your next Command phase, that Synaptic Imperative is active for your unit instead of any other Synaptic Imperative that is active for your army.

override_instincts.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army and made a Fall Back move this phase.
override_instincts.effect: Your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge this turn.

power_of_the_hive_mind.text: TYRANIDS PSYKER only. +1 S and +1 AP for the bearer's psychic weapons.

psychostatic_disruption.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE only. Enemy units arriving from Reserves cannot be set up within 12" of the bearer. Once per battle, in battle round 1 or 2, when your opponent says a unit will arrive from Strategic Reserves, roll D6: on a 4+ it cannot arrive this turn.

synaptic_control.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE only. Attacks allocated to the bearer get -1 Damage.

the_dirgeheart_of_kharis.text: TYRANIDS SYNAPSE only (Aura). Enemy units within 9" of the bearer get -1 Leadership.

rule.text: In your Command phase each HARVESTER unit can Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" (each unit once per phase): either one model regains up to D3+1 lost wounds, or one destroyed INFANTRY model (not a CHARACTER) returns with full wounds; ENDLESS MULTITUDE units get up to 3 models back instead.

broodguard_impulse.target: One Harvester unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
broodguard_impulse.effect: Until the end of the battle, each time a friendly TYRANIDS model makes an attack that targets the enemy unit that just destroyed your HARVESTER unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

reclaim_biomass.when: Any phase, when a TYRANIDS unit from your army is destroyed, before the last model in it is removed from play.
reclaim_biomass.target: One Harvester unit from your army that is within 6" of that destroyed unit.
reclaim_biomass.effect: Regenerate one friendly TYRANIDS unit within 6" of your HARVESTER unit (See Feed the Swarm).

tyrannoformed.target: One Harvester unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
tyrannoformed.effect: That objective marker remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.

ablative_carapace.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
ablative_carapace.target: One Harvester unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
ablative_carapace.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability. If your unit is within range of an objective marker you control, until the end of the phase models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability instead.

secure_biomass.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
secure_biomass.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. If your unit is a Harvester unit, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit as well.

rapacious_hunger.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that just destroyed an enemy unit.
rapacious_hunger.effect: Your unit immediately Regenerates (See Feed the Swarm). When doing so, if your unit is a Harvester unit and you choose for one model to regain up to D3 lost wounds, that model regains up to 3 lost wounds instead.

biophagic_flow.text: While a friendly HARVESTER model is within 12" of the bearer, it can Regenerate a unit within 9" instead of 6".

instinctive_defence.text: While the bearer is within 6" of a friendly HARVESTER unit, Heroic Intervention on its unit costs 1CP less and the unit has Fights First.

parasitic_biomorphology.text: +1 S for melee weapons in the bearer's unit. The first time the unit destroys an enemy unit in the Fight phase while the bearer is within 6" of a friendly HARVESTER, its melee weapons get +1 A for the rest of the battle.

regenerating_monstrosity.text: Not MONSTER models. The bearer's unit can be regenerated up to twice per phase.

rule.text: Each time a TYRANIDS MONSTER model from your army makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll if that model’s unit is below its Starting Strength , and add 1 to the Wound roll as well if that model’s unit is Below Half-strength .

corrosive_viscera.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Tyranids Monster model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability that cannot FLY is destroyed.
corrosive_viscera.target: That TYRANIDS MONSTER model. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.
corrosive_viscera.effect: Do not roll one D6 to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your model’s Deadly Demise ability. Instead, mortal wounds are automatically inflicted.

rampaging_monstrosities.target: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
rampaging_monstrosities.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

savage_roar.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
savage_roar.target: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
savage_roar.effect: That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that enemy unit makes an attack that targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. If that Battle-shock test was failed, subtract 1 from the Wound roll as well.

untrammelled_ferocity.target: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.
untrammelled_ferocity.effect:
Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through models (excluding TITANIC models) and sections of terrain features that are 4" or less in height. When doing so: 
It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models, but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them. It can also move through sections of terrain features that are more than 4" in height, but if it does, after its unit has moved, roll one D6: on a 1, your unit is Battle-shocked.

swarm_guided_salvoes.target: One Tyranids Monster unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
swarm_guided_salvoes.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that model’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

massive_impact.when: Your Charge phase, just after a Tyranids Monster model from your army ends a Charge move.
massive_impact.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of your model and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

enraged_reserves.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. If the bearer is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought this phase, roll D6: on a 3+ it can fight after the attacking unit finishes, then is removed.

monstrous_nemesis.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. +1 to wound for the bearer's melee attacks against MONSTER or VEHICLE units.

null_nodules.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER only. Once per battle, when a psychic attack is allocated to the bearer, it has Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks until the end of the phase.

ominous_presence.text: TYRANIDS MONSTER model only. Add 3 to the Objective Control characteristic of the bearer.

rule.text: TYRANIDS units can declare a charge in a turn in which they fell back; VANGUARD INVADER units can also declare a charge in a turn in which they advanced. Vanguard Prime: Deathleaper loses Hunter Organism and can be your Warlord.

surprise_assault.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a Vanguard Invader unit from your army has selected its targets.
surprise_assault.effect: Select one enemy unit that was selected as the target of one or more of your unit’s attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll. If the Battle-shock test was failed, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

assassin_beasts.target: One Vanguard Invader Infantry unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
assassin_beasts.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

seeded_broods.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that is in Reserves, or up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army that are in Reserves.
seeded_broods.effect: Until the end of the phase, for the purposes of setting up those selected units on the battlefield, treat the current battle round number as being one higher than it actually is.

hypersensory_scillia.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
hypersensory_scillia.target: Up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army that are within 9" of that enemy unit, or one other Tyranids Infantry unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit.
hypersensory_scillia.effect: Those selected units can each make a Normal move of up to 6".
hypersensory_scillia.restrictions: You cannot target units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

unseen_lurkers.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unseen_lurkers.target: One Vanguard Invader unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unseen_lurkers.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18" or, if your unit has the Lone Operative ability, if the attacking model is within 6". Your opponent can select new targets for the attacking unit’s attacks.

invisible_hunter.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
invisible_hunter.target: Up to two Vanguard Invader units from your army, or one Tyranids Infantry unit from your army.
invisible_hunter.effect: Remove the targeted units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.
invisible_hunter.restrictions: The targeted units must be more than 3" away from all enemy units.

chameleonic.text: VANGUARD INVADER only. The bearer's unit has Stealth.

hunting_grounds.text: While the bearer is on the battlefield, each time your opponent sets up a unit from Reserves, roll D6: on a 2+ that unit takes a battle-shock test.

neuronode.text: After both armies deploy, redeploy up to three VANGUARD INVADER units; any of them can go into Strategic Reserves regardless of the usual limit.

stalker.text: VANGUARD INVADER only. At the start of the battle pick one enemy unit: the bearer gets +1 to hit and +1 to wound against it.

rule.text: In your opponent’s Shooting phase , when an enemy unit has shot , if a model from a friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit was destroyed as a result of those attacks, that friendly unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

synaptic_goading.when: Any phase, just before an Endless Multitude unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a Surge move.
synaptic_goading.effect: When making that Surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker (instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit]. All other rules for making Surge moves still apply.

unending_waves.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
unending_waves.effect: Add a new unit to your army identical to your destroyed unit, in Strategic Reserves, at its Starting Strength.
unending_waves.restrictions: Any destroyed Character units that were attached to your unit are not returned. You can only use this Stratagem once per battle.

teeming_masses.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
teeming_masses.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
teeming_masses.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

swarming_masses.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
swarming_masses.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
swarming_masses.effect: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability, and If your unit contains 15 or more models, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.

bounding_advance.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army.
bounding_advance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Advances, do not make an Advance roll. Instead, until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in your unit.

preservation_imperative.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
preservation_imperative.target: One Endless Multitude unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
preservation_imperative.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit is treated as containing fewer than five models for the purpose of the [BLAST] ability.

adrenalised_onslaught.text: The bearer's unit can pile in and consolidate 3" further.

naturalised_camouflage.text: Start of the first battle round: pick up to three friendly ENDLESS MULTITUDE units within 9" of the bearer. Until the end of that round they have the benefit of cover against ranged attacks.

piercing_talons.text: Attacks by the bearer's unit get +1 AP on a critical wound.

relentless_hunger.text: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in the bearer's unit.

rule.text: Friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR units have Deep Strike . Friendly LICTOR/NEUROLICTOR units’ attacks that target a CHARACTER unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1.

counterpredation.when: Fight phase , when a friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR / VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit is selected to fight .
counterpredation.effect: Your unit’s attacks that target a hidden unit have +1 S and AP .

hypersensory_adaptations.target: One friendly DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR / VON RYAN’S LEAPERS unit.
hypersensory_adaptations.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has +6" detection range .

scanner_gheist.when: End of your opponent’s Fight phase .
scanner_gheist.target: One friendly unengaged DEATHLEAPER / LICTOR / NEUROLICTOR unit.
scanner_gheist.effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves .

cryptophotaic_camouflage.text: VON RYAN'S LEAPERS only. The unit has -3" detection range.

encircling_horrors.text: NEUROLICTOR, LICTOR or VON RYAN'S LEAPERS only. In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8", this unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

rule.text: Friendly NORN EMISSARY / NORN ASSIMILATOR units have the following ability: Protean Purpose: (Once per battle, per unit) In your Command phase , you can use this ability.

catalytic_biofortification.when: Any phase, when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit suffers a mortal wound .
catalytic_biofortification.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds .

lesser_prey.when: Fight phase , when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR / NORN EMISSARY unit is selected to fight .
lesser_prey.effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have +2 S .

tanglestrike_rounds.when: Your Shooting phase , when a friendly NORN ASSIMILATOR unit has shot .
tanglestrike_rounds.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is tethered until the start of your next Command phase : While a unit is tethered , that unit has -2" M .

destabilising_predation.text: NORN EMISSARY only. Its ranged attacks have [ANTI-CHARACTER 2+].

synaptoprescience.text: NORN ASSIMILATOR only. It has a 4+ invulnerable save.

rule.text: Friendly TYRANID WARRIORS WITH RANGED BIO-WEAPONS / TYRANID WARRIORS WITH MELEE BIO-WEAPONS units have: TYRANID WARRIORS . TYRANID WARRIORS / TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP / WINGED TYRANID PRIME models from your army have 5+ InSv .

alien_physiology.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
alien_physiology.target: One TYRANIDS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
alien_physiology.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability. If your unit is within Synapse Range of your army, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability instead.

synaptic_micronodes.target: One Tyranid Warriors unit from your army.
synaptic_micronodes.effect: Select one objective marker you control that your unit is within range of. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

parasitic_payload.target: One Tyranid Warriors with Ranged Bio-weapons unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
parasitic_payload.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has resolved its shooting attacks this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the turn, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

elevated_might.text: WINGED TYRANID PRIME or TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP only. The bearer's melee attacks can re-roll wound rolls and get +1 AP.

ocular_adaptation.text: WINGED TYRANID PRIME or TYRANID PRIME WITH LASH WHIP only. Melee attacks by the bearer's unit get +1 to hit.

Hive Commander.text: Start of your Command phase: if this model is on the battlefield, gain 1CP.

Malign Presence (Aura).text: Once per turn, when your opponent targets one of their units within 12" of this model with a Stratagem, you can make that use cost 1CP more.

Domination of the Hive Mind (Aura).text: Friendly TYRANIDS units within 9" of this model are within your army's Synapse Range.

Alpha Leader.text: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit can re-roll hit rolls.

Unstoppable Monster.text: At the start of each player's Command phase this model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

Fear of the Unseen (Aura).text: Enemy units within 6" get -1 Leadership. In the battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each such unit below its Starting Strength must take a battle-shock test.

Hunter Organism.text: This model cannot be your Warlord.

Feeder Tendrils.text: Each time this model destroys an enemy CHARACTER model, gain 1CP.

Swallow Whole.text: Gaping maw attacks against INFANTRY, MOUNTED or BEASTS units turn every successful unmodified wound roll into a critical wound. Each such model the maw destroys heals this model by up to D3+2 wounds.

Subterranean Hunter.text: End of the Fight phase: if not engaged, you can remove this unit and place it into Strategic Reserves.

Onslaught (Aura, Psychic).text: Ranged weapons of friendly TYRANIDS units within 6" have [ASSAULT] and [LETHAL HITS].

Will of the Hive Mind.text: Once per battle round (one model with this ability per army): when a friendly TYRANIDS unit within 12" is targeted with a Stratagem, that use costs 1CP less.

Encephalic Diffusion (Aura, Psychic).text: Enemy units within 6" get -1 to hit; if they are below half strength, also -1 to wound.

Harpoon Barbs.text: Once per turn, when an enemy unit engaged with this model is selected to fall back, roll D6: on a 2+ it takes D6 mortal wounds.

Singular Purpose.text: Start of the first battle round, choose one: an enemy unit (this model can re-roll hit and wound rolls against it for the rest of the battle), or an objective marker (while within its range, this model has Feel No Pain 5+ and OC 15).

Feeding Frenzy.text: Each time this model makes a melee attack that targets a unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that unit is also Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

Hive Defences.text: You can use Fire Overwatch on this model for 0CP, even if another unit already used it this turn (this model once per turn).

Grasping Tendrils.text: When an engaged enemy unit (not TITANIC) is selected to fall back from units with this ability, roll D6: on a 3+ it must remain stationary instead.

Hypertoxic Miasma (Aura).text: End of your Movement phase: roll D6 for each enemy unit within 6". 2-3: 1 mortal wound; 4-5: D3 mortal wounds; 6: D6 mortal wounds.

Subterranean Tunnels.text: Your Movement phase: when this model is set up by Deep Strike it can use a tunnel and be set up anywhere more than 6" horizontally from all enemy units, but it cannot declare a charge that turn.

Resilient Organism.text: Once per battle, when an attack is allocated to this model, you can change that attack's Damage to 0.

Frenzied Metabolism.text: When this model is selected to shoot you can use this: +1 to wound for its attacks until the end of the phase; afterwards roll D6, on a 2+ it takes D3 mortal wounds.

Apex-beast.text: Each time this model makes an attack that targets a Battle-shocked unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Stalking Forward.text: On Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves it can move over models (not TITANIC) and terrain 4" tall or less as if they were not there.

Chitinous Horrors (Aura).text: Enemy models engaged with this unit have their OC halved.
